mapper.select: SELECT id FROM store WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{store} AND status=1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id,p.name,p.price,COALESCE(m.on_sale,0) on_sale,COALESCE(m.sold_out,0) sold_out, m.override_price,COALESCE(m.sort,0) sort FROM dish p LEFT JOIN store_dish m ON m.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND m.dish_id=p.id AND m.store_id=#{store} WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY COALESCE(m.sort,0),p.id

SELECT p.id,p.name,p.price,COALESCE(m.on_sale,0) on_sale,COALESCE(m.sold_out,0) sold_out, m.override_price,COALESCE(m.sort,0) sort FROM setmeal p LEFT JOIN store_setmeal m ON m.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND m.setmeal_id=p.id AND m.store_id=#{store} WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY COALESCE(m.sort,0),p.id

SELECT p.id,p.name,p.category_id,p.image,p.description,p.status,p.update_time,COALESCE(m.override_price,p.price) price FROM dish p JOIN store_dish m ON m.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND m.dish_id=p.id JOIN store s ON s.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND s.id=m.store_id JOIN tenant t ON t.id=s.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.id=#{store} AND s.status=1 AND t.status=1 AND p.status=1 AND m.on_sale=1 AND m.sold_out=0 AND p.category_id=#{categoryId} ORDER BY m.sort,p.id

SELECT p.id,p.name,p.category_id,p.image,p.description,p.status,p.update_time,COALESCE(m.override_price,p.price) price FROM setmeal p JOIN store_setmeal m ON m.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND m.setmeal_id=p.id JOIN store s ON s.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND s.id=m.store_id JOIN tenant t ON t.id=s.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.id=#{store} AND s.status=1 AND t.status=1 AND p.status=1 AND m.on_sale=1 AND m.sold_out=0 AND p.category_id=#{categoryId} ORDER BY m.sort,p.id
